How it works

Drag points and the area's corners on the map; drag elsewhere to pan, wheel to zoom. “Here” puts a point where you stand in game, “TP” takes you to it. Click a door on the map (or pick in the Doors list) to choose whether the event opens it, shuts it, or leaves it as the world has it. A moved point takes the height of the ground under it at once (the floor nearest the one it was on), and again when you save. Saving writes data/conquest/<id>.xml and redraws the waypoints of anyone showing the map in game. The event picks one enabled map with spawn points for both teams and at least one capture point.

    New map around you

    The area starts 24000 × 20000 around where you stand in game, without points.
